newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour promises tougher competition law.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour promises tougher competition law.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party said an early priority if it wins the May 1 election will be to reform Britain's competition law with the aim of bringing value and quality to consumers.
"We will adopt a tough, 'prohibitive' approach to deter anti-competitive practices and abuses of market power," the party's manifesto said on Thursday.
It said that it would promote competition in the utility industries wherever possible.

"Where competition is not an effective discipline, for example in the water industry, which had a poor environmental record and had been in most cases a tax-free zone, we will pursue tough, efficient regulation in the interests of customers, and, in the case of water, in the interests of the environment as well," the manifesto said.
